question: Can public primary/official same-analysis sources supply separate 0-30 keV reconstructed-energy templates for neutron, solar-8B, accidental, and surface/wall backgrounds used by the PandaX-4T 0.63 tonne-year commissioning analysis?

audit_routes.finding: The public release index lists the commissioning First Analysis release and later PandaX-4T releases, but no dedicated numerical release for PRL 129, 161804 / arXiv:2206.02339. The First Analysis page exposes only eff_RDQ_graph.root and PandaX4T_Data_ne.xlsx; no four separated 0-30 keV minor-background templates are listed.
SCOAP3 record for DOI 10.1103/PhysRevLett.129.161804 exposes fulltext PDF and XML only; no supplementary numerical files/templates are listed.

queries: Search for Light Fermionic Dark Matter Absorption on Electrons in PandaX-4T
audit_routes.finding: No HEPData record tied to the exact DOI/arXiv/title was found in the public exact searches performed for this gate.
No author/collaboration public repository or numerical package explicitly tied to the same analysis and containing the four required separated templates was found.

Component-specific papers/analyses exist (for example the PandaX-4T neutron-background study), but they do not provide a complete same-selection set of four reconstructed-energy templates with all required detector-response/selection provenance. Later or different PandaX analyses cannot be substituted without an explicit identity mapping, which is absent.

scientific_consequence: The full-profile PandaX/De-Romeri B-L likelihood route is retired as blocked under current public-primary inputs. The accepted 0073a observed spectrum and efficiency remain valid data products but do not authorize a B-L contour.
next_gate: Prospectively freeze a different compatible primary B-L constraint family; prioritize an independently reproducible COHERENT CsI+Ar CEvNS likelihood/contour route rather than weakening the PandaX nuisance model.
